purpose: Complete cold bundle compression and explicit receiver-root transfer accounting, not universal superiority

funnel.S: BODY_ONLY / WHOLE_BUNDLE; META / VERBATIM; EMBEDDED / EXTERNAL; precomputed or provided exact pool; cold/warm cost
funnel.CM1: Exact typed input/container/pool roots, supported nonrecursive wrapper, resource bounds, byte/text inverses
funnel.CM2: Least charged delivery bytes over verified candidates; full cold bytes retained separately
funnel.IC: Ordered roots, requested layout/mode/codec/placement, receiver-declared exact roots, accounting and operation sequence
funnel.IR: Actual candidate bytes, inverses, selected receipt; no receiver possession/authentication claim

wrapper.body: XZ(LZMA2 preset6) of one complete byte-exact self-contained metalegend .crys archive

accounting.COLD: archive bytes + external pool bytes once
accounting.WARM: archive bytes + external pool bytes unless exact root appears in receiver declaration

shared_pool.coverage: Every requested stored record must exist; supersets permitted; missing record refuses
shared_pool.not: A CSIL/GTK semantic identity merge or an implicit append
